intelligence.human_view: Think of a house. Right now Settings is one room with everything piled in it — the thermostat, the photo albums, the mail, the tools — and you have to dig through the pile to find the one thing you came for. Shawn's fix is simple: put a door on the front and label the rooms. You click Settings and the door opens onto the house — Set Your World first, because who you are comes before what you tune, then Notifications, Cover Buttons, Common Settings, each its own room. And inside each room, everything opens the same way: one frame, one thing at a time, like turning the pages of a beautiful book — one question, one frame, next. The messenger is a conversation held whole in a frame that grows as you scroll, until it's completed. The mail is a real letter in a frame, paper you could hold. And the colours down the sidebar run like the spectrum itself, in order, never repeating, never skipping — purple and magenta both kept, each at its most beautiful, because neighbours are not twins.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine every toy comes in its own beautiful box! You open one box, and inside is just one toy to play with! That is how every part of Naya works now! Settings is a door: you open it and see all the rooms! The first room is all about YOU — who you are! Letters come in pretty frames, like real letters! And chats grow bigger as you scroll, like a story that keeps going! Every colour gets its own turn, and no colour ever pushes another one out!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — imagine Settings is the front door of a lovely house, dear! You open it and there are the rooms, each with its name on the door — and the first room is all about you, love, who you are! Each question gets its own beautiful frame, dear, one at a time, never a long form to scroll! Your letters arrive like real letters in pretty frames, love! And your chats grow as you read, like a story that keeps going! Every colour takes its turn, dear — purple and pink both kept, each one beautiful, each one easy to tell apart!
intelligence.naya_view: Settings is a door: click it and the menu lists each area — Set Your World first, then Notifications, Cover Buttons, Common Settings — nothing crammed into All Settings. Set Your World opens on the person — age, adult, male/female, age range, where they live, where they're from — one question per frame, multiple choice, click next until answered, the walkthrough's flow harvested verbatim. The spectrum runs through Settings — each block a new colour on hover, never one colour per section. The menu is long enough for all areas and scrolls; each entry an obsidian button lighting its own colour, raised icon like the Hub sidebars; entries include install-app-on-page and public on/off. THE FRAME IS THE STANDARD for every pop-up and feature display, frame by frame. The messenger sits in an EXPANDABLE frame that grows with the scroll until completed. Smart Mail is a framed letter — high contrast, raised boards, text like the intelligent boards — studied against the elite, built 10× better. Seen is the reader's face orb; labels 17px; voice notes 1.5×/2×. The sidebar flow runs the settled sequence in order — no repeats, no gaps — the same on Dashboard and Hub. Keep both magenta and purple, each at its most beautiful, high contrast at a glance; Dashboard anchors on points purple, Hub stays magenta.
